one_line_claim: On the 1900-2012 full overlap, the demand take-off precedes the schooling take-off in 10.0% of identifiable countries under the GGDC non-agricultural-employment proxy (2 of 20 identifiable; 30 in-window; 37 with both series).
caveats: Recomputed in-session from the committed CSV. 'Identifiable'=forward+reverse+forward_or_tie and excludes 10 undetermined; all-country bounds for this proxy are 6.7-40.0%.

one_line_claim: Same window, WDI urbanisation proxy: demand-first 15.4% of identifiable countries (10/65; 101 in-window; 143 with both series).
caveats: Recomputed in-session. Bounds 9.9-45.5%.

one_line_claim: Same window, WDI industry value-added proxy: demand-first 24.1% (13/54; 76 in-window).
caveats: Recomputed in-session. Bounds 17.1-46.1%.

one_line_claim: Same window, WDI agricultural value-added (falling) proxy: demand-first 18.8% (9/48; 83 in-window).
caveats: Recomputed in-session. Bounds 10.8-53.0%.

one_line_claim: Across the four full-overlap proxies the demand-first share is 10.0-24.1% of identifiable countries, all below the pre-registered one-third decision threshold.
caveats: Recomputed 10.00-24.07%. The one-third threshold is in PRE_REGISTRATION.md.

one_line_claim: Over all countries with both series (not only identifiable ones), the demand-first share bounds are 6.7-53.0% across the four proxies.
caveats: Recomputed min lower bound 6.7 and max upper bound 53.0. The width is the honest uncertainty; do not quote only the point estimates.

one_line_claim: A further 21-43% of in-window countries are weak forward ties or left-censored, i.e. demand-first cannot be excluded but cannot be strictly ordered.
caveats: Recomputed 21.05-43.33% of in-window countries. Weak category is reported separately by the record's discipline.

one_line_claim: Strict schooling-first is the larger strict ordering: 21.5-46.3% of identifiable countries and 58.3-71.4% of strict orderings. The record's prose '18-33% strict schooling-first' does NOT reproduce.
caveats: Recomputed in-session from e6_summary.csv: 21.54-46.30% identifiable, 58.33-71.43% strict. 18-33% must not be quoted (ERRATUM section A). Schooling-first is NOT a majority of identifiable countries (max 46.3%).

one_line_claim: The correct wording is 'larger strict ordering', not 'majority strict ordering': schooling-first exceeds demand-first in all four proxies but is a majority only among strict orderings.
caveats: Wording correction in ERRATUM section A. Original sentence left visible in REPORT.md line 53.

one_line_claim: Across 54 committed N3 definitions (all n>=20) the strict demand-first share ranges 0.0-30.8% with median 10.45%; the ordering is threshold- and smoothing-sensitive and cannot be quoted as one percentage.
caveats: Recomputed: 54 definitions, min 0.0, max 30.8, median 10.45. Companion JSON n3_recommendation.json.

one_line_claim: N3 q1 default definition (Delta_s=1.0, Delta_r=3.0pp, no smoothing; n=34): demand-first strict 6.2%, weak tie 70.6%, schooling-first 17.6%, undetermined 5.9%; all-country bounds 5.9-82.4%.
caveats: Recomputed q1 row: 2/24/6/2 of 34; forward_share_incl_ties 81.2.

one_line_claim: The N3 weak forward-or-tie share is 56.67-88.46% of identifiable countries (50.00-82.14% of all countries in each definition). The record's prose '56-84%' does NOT reproduce.
caveats: Recomputed from n3_table.csv. ERRATUM section C. No denominator yields endpoints 56 and 84.

one_line_claim: The primary E6 comparison window is the full overlap 1900-2012; the pre-registered 1960-2010 window is reported as robustness because it selects against pre-1960 demand take-offs. This is a documented deviation, not the pre-registered plan.
caveats: PRE_REGISTRATION.md names 1960-2010 primary. REPORT.md section 4 item 1 declares the deviation. Must be presented as a deviation.

one_line_claim: E6 dates 'massification' by a reconstructed mean-years-of-schooling take-off (5-year grid, 1870-2020), not by secondary/tertiary enrolment threshold crossings; and 'industrialisation' by non-ag employment / urbanisation / VA shares, not manufacturing. The title's implied enrolment-threshold test is not in the record.
caveats: No committed file dates secondary/tertiary enrolment threshold crossings. This is a framing gap, flagged in GAPS.md sections 4-5; new analysis needed.

one_line_claim: Illustrative country rows (GGDC proxy): CHN schooling onset 1930 vs demand 1962; PHL 1945 vs 1972; BOL demand 1958 vs schooling 1965; IND demand 1976 vs schooling 1980.
caveats: Illustration only, not a case sample. Schooling onsets are from the RECONSTRUCTED series; check series_first_year for left-censoring before using any row in text.

one_line_claim: Penn World Table 10.01 is OBSERVED but has no sectoral employment split, so it is used for context only and cannot date a structural take-off.
caveats: REPORT.md section 0 and section 4 item 3. Do not use PWT as a demand-timing proxy.

one_line_claim: The 8 verified fee-abolition dates are MWI 1994, ETH 1995, UGA 1997, LSO 2000, TZA 2001, KEN 2003, MOZ 2004, GHA 2005; each is quoted with a page/box locator in a 2009 World Bank/UNICEF volume.
caveats: Recomputed: 12 rows, 8 VERIFIED. Blob 85d09f86... byte-identical to the source-verification copy at 9a0fd69 and the paper copy at fb9f419.

one_line_claim: Four fee dates are UNRESOLVED (CMR 1999/2000, ZMB 2002, RWA 2003, BDI 2005) and are excluded from the main specification, entering only the all-12 sensitivity.
caveats: Recomputed: 4 UNRESOLVED. Do not silently drop or guess them (record rule: 'do not guess').

one_line_claim: Under Callaway-Sant'Anna (universal base g-1, not-yet-treated controls), the post-period primary-GER ATTs for the verified-8 sample are +23.82 [+2.05,45.60] at +1 through +25.92 [8.64,43.20] at +6, i.e. roughly +22 to +29 points.
caveats: Recomputed post range 22.12-28.56. This is the range the auditor's '+22-29 pp' quote refers to; it is not the on-impact or sensitivity-mean estimate.

one_line_claim: The on-impact (+0) ATT is +12.44 with 95% CI [-2.36, 27.24], which includes zero.
caveats: Recomputed. Report explicitly; do not let the post-period range obscure the zero on-impact.

one_line_claim: Pre-trends at -2/-3/-4 are flat (-0.03 [-3.43,3.38]; -0.13 [-7.23,6.98]; 1.35 [-6.35,9.04]); at -5 the estimate is 6.39 [-0.08,12.86] on only 6 treated cohorts, weak evidence of a pre-trend at the earliest horizon.
caveats: Recomputed. The -5 horizon must be reported as imprecise, not hidden.

one_line_claim: Placebo dates shifted 6 years earlier give a mean post ATT of -0.39.
caveats: Recomputed.

one_line_claim: Leave-one-country-out mean post ATT ranges 18.17-26.16; the sign and rough magnitude do not depend on any single country.
All-12-dates sensitivity mean post ATT is 20.80; shifting all dates +1 year gives 12.31 and -1 year gives 18.65.
caveats: Recomputed. Date shifts move the timing (especially on-impact) not the direction.

one_line_claim: Secondary GER (the labelled proxy for the requested lower-secondary outcome) shows post ATTs of +6.71 [-3.39,16.82] at +5 and +6.07 [-0.01,12.16] at +6, pre-trends flat, every CI including zero: a proxy with no clear detected effect.
caveats: Recomputed. WDI publishes no annual lower-secondary GER; secondary GER is a proxy. Report as no clear detected effect, NOT as a null.

one_line_claim: The verified-8 event table has 28-30 control countries per event; 25-30 is the all-12 sensitivity range. The record's '25-30 controls' prose is the wrong range for the main table.
caveats: Recomputed n_controls 28-30 verified8. ERRATUM section D.1.

one_line_claim: The TWFE comparison event study gives post-period estimates of 21.05-27.65 points, similar in direction and magnitude to the CS estimates.
caveats: Recomputed post TWFE 21.05-27.65. TWFE is a comparison, not the preferred estimator.

one_line_claim: Seven treated countries have primary-GER outcome data (one verified country lacks coverage), and the -5/+3/+5 horizons have 6 treated countries.
caveats: Recomputed n_treated varies 6-7 across events. Small sample: wide CIs, no causal claim.

one_line_claim: The 8 dates are labelled 'primary-verified' by the project, but in strict terms each is quoted at a named page/box in two 2009 World Bank/UNICEF compilations; no underlying ministry decree, arrete, or Education Act was retrieved.
caveats: For a strict primary-source standard all 8 need the underlying legal/administrative instrument. The page/box locators and quotes themselves are committed in README.md Job 1.

caveats: Hashes read from the file. Network access to the same releases is required; long_run_panel.csv is at research/records/2026-11-24-next-tests/data @ assessment-and-next-experiments-2026-11-24.

caveats: Recorded in REPORT.md section 0 and PRE_REGISTRATION.md purpose. Must not be used in Paper #2.

caveats: Recomputed. ERRATUM section C. Recommended: 56.7-88.5% of identifiable countries or 50.0-82.1% of all countries.

one_line_claim: The E8 prose clause 'mean post 18-29 points' does not reproduce; reproducible mean-post values are 12.31 (all+1), 18.65 (all-1), 20.80 (all-12), leave-one-out 18.17-26.16, placebo -0.39, and the verified-8 mean of post ATTs is 25.26.
